This is fundamentally wrong for deflection and slope calculations. A UDL over the entire span of a cantilever yields max deflection = wL⁴/(8EI) and slope = wL³/(6EI), while a point load at midspan gives entirely different results. The ground truth requires applying Euler-Bernoulli theory directly to the UDL case, not an equivalent point load approximation. This alteration would produce incorrect numerical answers for both the maximum deflection and the slope at the free end.
